# ACI Africa

> > ACI Africa delivers comprehensive Catholic news coverage across the African continent, featuring papal visits, Vatican updates, and regional Church developments.

ACI Africa serves as the primary Catholic news agency for Africa, reporting on Pope Francis, episcopal conferences like AMECEA and CEPACS, religious persecution, interfaith dialogue, and synodal church initiatives across nations including Nigeria, Algeria, Angola, and Cameroon.

## Key Topics

- Pope Leo XIV
- Pope Francis
- Vatican news
- AMECEA (Association of Member Episcopal Conferences in Eastern Africa)
- CEPACS (Pan African Episcopal Committee for Social Communications)
- Catholic Men Association (CMA)
- Nigeria religious persecution
- Papal visits to Africa
- Synodal Church initiatives
- Interfaith dialogue
- Religious violence
- St. Matilda
- African Catholic Church
- Episcopal conferences
- African Catholic news

## Main

- [ACI Africa](http://www.aciafrica.org/): Homepage for ACI Africa Catholic news covering Pope Francis and Vatican
